name: github-plan-wiki
description: Create template-aware GitHub issues and pull requests with per-issue closing keywords, keep issue planning statuses in sync across parent and sub-issues, and publish approved plans to the GitHub wiki in English and Japanese.

interface.shortDescription: Template-aware issues, statuses, PR closure, and wiki plans
interface.longDescription: Turns approved plans into template-aware GitHub issue hierarchies and bilingual wiki pages, keeps issue planning statuses in sync across parent and sub-issues, and creates or updates PRs with evidence-based acceptance tracking, repository templates, issue links, and readback.
defaultPrompt: Break this approved plan into a parent issue and sub-issues with $github-plan-issues.
Start work on this issue and update its status and its parent's with $github-issue-status.
Publish this approved plan to the GitHub wiki with $github-wiki-plan.
Create a template-aware PR with per-issue closing keywords using $github-pull-request.
